column1: # Where the spelling check and the allow-zfwj flag change the answer.
# sp-off-zzas: with the check off the s mark lands on an unresolvable cluster; with it on it does not
# sp-restore-break: a break key runs checkRestoreIfWrongSpelling with vRestoreAndStartNewSession
#   (Engine.cpp:1335-1341); the invalid `asd` word is replaced by its raw keys, then `.` passes through.
# sp-restore-space: the space branch forces the check and restores with vRestore (Engine.cpp:1384-1397);
#   the raw word is followed by the literal space.
# sp-restore-off: the flag-off control; with restore disabled the marked word is kept and the space passes.
# sp-zfwj-zas-on: allow-zfwj is what lets z start a syllable, so the s can land on it
# sp-zfwj-jis-on: allow-zfwj is what lets j start a syllable, so the s can land on it.
# w is not the test, because telex already reads w as ư with the flag off.
